sv.title: Chaufför rattsurfade i tio minuter – med fullsatt buss
sv.summary: Anita Spaak åker nästintill dagligen med Jönköpings länstrafiks bussar från sitt hem i Brandstorp i Habo kommun. Under sina år som bussresenär har hon otaliga gånger sett chaufförer prata i telefon eller surfa på mobilen under färden.

en.title: Bus driver browsed on phone at the wheel for ten minutes – with a full bus
en.summary: Anita Spaak rides Jönköpings länstrafik buses almost daily from her home in Brandstorp in Habo municipality. During her years as a bus passenger, she has countless times seen drivers talking on the phone or browsing on their mobile during the journey.
